about_story_content: We celebrate West African flavors with a Montréal twist. Dough mixed daily, fried golden, finished with house glazes & spices. From family gatherings to late-night cravings, we make joy—one bite at a time.

about_franchise_subtitle: Bring authentic African donuts to your city with our training, playbooks, and launch support.
about_franchise_requirements_list: Ability to obtain permits & manage a grease trap

about_franchise_faq_items.q: What is the typical timeline to open?
about_franchise_faq_items.a: From signing to grand opening, the process typically takes 3 to 6 months, depending on site selection and construction.
While helpful, it's not mandatory. We provide comprehensive training. A passion for quality and customer service is most important.

about_franchise_faq_items.q: Can I convert an existing location?
about_franchise_faq_items.a: Yes, we are open to conversions if the location meets our criteria and can be adapted to our brand standards.

about_franchise_faq_items.q: Do I get a protected territory?
about_franchise_faq_items.a: Yes, each franchisee receives a protected territory defined by demographic data and population density.
